Tess A: heads-up: finalizing internal release note for 2.18.0. plan to post at 17:30 PT. need final check on pin commands and rollback bullets.
Ravi P: pasting draft now. will include exact model SHAs and rbinctl examples.
Docs Lisa: PR link: https://phab/repo/PR-4991 (internal announce + rollback runbook). trimmed customer-facing bullets.
deploy-bot: preflight OK, snapshot snap-2026-03-23-1650 created.
Oncall-May: i'll be on standby 17:15-19:15. please add kill-switch command and authorized list.
Ravi P: added into PR:
```n# pin
rbinctl pin --env=prod --model=redwood-std --hash=ffee3344
# kill-switch (oncall only)
rbinctl traffic --env=prod --set-canary=0
```
Tess A: rollback criteria (short): ANY of -> 5m error rate >=2% OR P95 token latency +40% OR >=2 smoke test failures => set canary=0 and notify #eng-oncall. If TWO criteria met, escalate to SEV and follow runbook. full details in PR.
Ravi P: canary plan: 5% for 20m -> 30% for 20m -> full. Add note to wait 3 minutes after setting canary=0 to validate stabilization.
Oncall-May: agree. add explicit instruction: "only oncall or release leads may trigger kill-switch". i'll confirm standby in thread.
Tess A: timeline: 16:00 final copy to ops, 16:30 SHAs locked, 17:15 oncall confirmed, 17:30 deploy window.
Docs Lisa: one-liner for deploybot: "Rolling out 2.18.0 to hosted/dedicated. Canary 5% -> 30% -> full. Rollback details in internal note."
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window 17:30-18:30 PT, quiet-mode set to #eng-oncall.
Ravi P: pasted exact model SHAs into internal note.
Tess A: checklist done. i'll post internal blast at 17:35 with the short announce and link to runbook. thanks :rocket:
